summary: A Harley Street non surgical aesthetics clinic appears to lose bookings to stray page code, unshown proof and no WhatsApp.

findings.problem: Stray markup characters appear about six times in the page text near the header and menu.
findings.cost: Broken code on the first screen looks careless at premium prices.

findings.problem: A Trustpilot label appears with no rating or review shown beside it.
findings.cost: A rating you do not show cannot persuade a new patient.
findings.fix: The live rating and two review quotes on the homepage.

findings.problem: A Multi Award Winning claim appears with no named awards or years visible.
findings.cost: Unnamed awards are easy to doubt.
findings.fix: Name each award with its year and logo.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, and the footer copyright line appears to have no year.
findings.cost: Patients who want a quick answer message other clinics first.
findings.fix: WhatsApp on every page and a current footer year.
